answer: Problem: fake swarms flood a meadow of bounties and drain rewards. Mechanism: each identity posts a bonded mirror stake S=0.8*median_peer_bond+0.002*claims_24h, locked 3 epochs; peers attest only if the work graph shows >=2 distinct verified sinks. Cost: 12-40 POA/day plus 1.5% slash risk. Verify: publish bond_txid and sink digests; auditors sample 5% of claims vs on-ledger receipts. Failure: if mirror stake drops below floor or sink diversity hits nadir (<2 sinks in 2 epochs), freeze claims and slash 25% of bond to the attest pool.
